pages: Welcome to HOLY_GRAIL, the Quest for the Ultimate E-Companion.
This is a big update: we now have 4 Samplers, a master compressor and a PUMP engine.
The WIKI docs explain everything. The app now works on iPhone, iPad and Apple Silicon Macs as well.
The way the looper sounds needs a bit more work, but it should be better than the last version.
Please send me a message on how it works for you with SEND LOG on the settings page! The quest needs it!
If you use anything other than the Digitakt, please let me know how it works! Syntakts, Digitones! Excited to hear from you!
